name: primary-source-external-DIII-D-data-feasibility-scan
method: Read-only primary-source web review. No archive data, model weights, large files, competition private labels or credentials were downloaded or accessed.

sources.observation: The organizers explicitly permit public tokamak archives and OMFIT-produced equilibrium tables if disclosed in the methods report. Permission to use external public data does not establish its availability or disjointness.

The competition describes 7,041 labeled DIII-D train shots and 874 public inputs, but says machine shot numbers are not part of the released dataset; its blind private fold is withheld. Exact identity-based overlap checking against an outside shot-number list cannot be done from the public release alone.

The EFIT-AI project described an approximately 2,500-discharge DIII-D 2019 database with magnetics-only, magnetics-plus-MSE, and some kinetic equilibrium reconstructions. This establishes potentially relevant labeled equilibria, not an accessible challenge-matching download.

Official utility documentation demonstrates validating and extracting equilibria from local HDF5 paths. It does not provide a verified public corpus manifest, direct bulk-download endpoint, 21 allowed actuator-current and Thomson-field mapping, or data license for those HDF5 files.
The official GitLab project identifies itself as utilities for database creation, validation, manipulation, extraction and analysis; it is not itself verified to host the equilibrium corpus.
DIII-D describes research-data access as open but controlled through institutional user agreements and program accounts. That route is not an immediate public-download path.
The Open FUSION Toolkit DIII-D page is a solver example based on a gEQDSK equilibrium; it does not document a shot-level corpus with matching allowed currents, Thomson inputs and EFIT ψ labels.

missing_before_use: An official accessible shot/file manifest and clear data license for a genuinely external labeled DIII-D corpus.
A demonstrated per-shot schema with the challenge-permitted 21 current signals, Thomson profiles, EFIT time grid and ψ targets in compatible units and time bases.

An auditable disjointness proof against all competition train, public and private shots; hidden machine identifiers make public shot-number comparison insufficient. An organizer-provided crosswalk or equivalent authoritative overlap check would be needed.
cheap_future_feasibility_gate: Inspect an official manifest/schema/license and a few metadata-only sample records; stop if any required input/label or disjointness proof is unavailable. Do not bulk-download or fit first.
verdict: No external source found in this bounded primary-source review can presently be treated as a clean disjoint supervised training set. No public-score improvement is inferred.
